mapper.select: select r.reservation_id, r.reserve_date,r.reserve_time,mc.card_id,mc.patient_name, mc.gender,mc.contact_phone,mc.age,dept.dept_name,d.doctor_name, r.is_receive as isReceive from reservation r inner join doctor d on d.doctor_no = r.doctor_no inner join medical_cards mc on mc.card_id = r.card_id inner join dept on d.dept_id = dept.dept_id where d.doctor_no=#{doctorNo};
mapper.insert: insert into medical_histories (medical_history, patient_description, doctor_advice, doctor_name, card_id, reservation_id) values (#{medical_history}, #{patientDescription}, #{doctorAdvice}, #{doctorName}, #{cardId}, #{reservationId})
mapper.update: update reservation set is_receive = 1 where reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from medical_histories where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and card_id = #{cardId}
select count(*) from medical_histories where reservation_id = #{reservationId}

select r.reserve_date as reserveDate, r.reserve_time as reserveTime, mc.patient_name as patientName, mc.gender, mc.age, mc.contact_phone as contactPhone, dept.dept_name as deptName, d.doctor_name as doctorName, mh.medical_history as medicalHistory, mh.patient_description as patientDescription, mh.doctor_advice as doctorAdvice from medical_histories mh inner join reservation r on mh.reservation_id = r.reservation_id inner join medical_cards mc on mh.card_id = mc.card_id inner join doctor d on r.doctor_no = d.doctor_no inner join dept on d.dept_id = dept.dept_id where r.is_receive = 1 and r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
